edits.old: The field-level detail of the consumed approval answer — property names, types, lengths and required flags — is Not specified in the source documents beyond "Read one approval with its routing details for the decision screen" (GAP-0641; ASM-1032),
edits.new: The consumed approval answer is ApprovalDetail of rwb-decision.yaml (API-P7-008): `id` (string, uuid), `status` (string) and `decision` (string) are the elements this contract reads for the approval id, the status and the decision code, and its `level` element is never read as an autonomy level. ApprovalDetail declares no element for the approved autonomy level or the approver identity, and no lengths or required flags: these are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0641; ASM-1032),
